title: Reproducing and documenting bugs
learningObjectives: Explain reproducing and documenting bugs and use browser or version-control tools to diagnose and publish reliable web projects.

understand.concept: A useful bug report includes expected and actual behaviour, reproducible steps, environment details, screenshots or logs when safe, and the smallest reliable reproduction. Remove personal data and secrets before sharing evidence.
understand.whyItMatters: Clear reproduction steps reduce investigation time and prevent assumptions. Environment details help identify browser-specific or device-specific failures.
understand.analogy: A bug report is a map that lets another person follow the same path to the problem.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; actual developer tools, Git behaviour, and deployment requirements depend on the browser, repository, and hosting provider.

explain.narrative: The object shows a concise structure for a reproducible report. Add real environment details and sanitized evidence when reporting an actual defect.

examples.code: const report={title:'Lesson button does not load starter code',steps:['Open CSS C4.11','Select the practice tab','Activate Load starter'],expected:'Starter code appears in the editor',actual:'Editor remains unchanged',environment:'Browser and version to be recorded'};console.log(report);
examples.explanation: The object shows a concise structure for a reproducible report. Add real environment details and sanitized evidence when reporting an actual defect.
examples.expectedOutput: The example illustrates the workflow or developer-tool concept; command examples require a practice repository.

practise.guidedTask: Write a bug report for a reproducible issue. Include environment, steps, expected/actual results, and a minimal example.
practise.independentTask: Apply the workflow to a small static site. Capture the commands or browser evidence, identify risks, and document recovery steps.
hints: Inspect actual files and browser behaviour.
Do not commit secrets or personal data.
Verify provider-specific deployment values before changing DNS.
